onChange.script:
message = self.custom.errorMessage
	if not message:
		return
	system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'error', 'message': message})
	if 'uncertain' in message.lower() or 'supervisor' in message.lower() or 'could not load' in message.lower():
		system.perspective.openPopup('receivingErrorDetail', 'kanoa/core/templates/displays/messagePopup', {'text': message}, title='Receiving error', modal=True)
	return

config.script:
self.view.custom.loading = True
	self.view.custom.errorMessage = ''
	try:
		if self.view.custom.startDate is None or self.view.custom.endDate is None:
			self.view.custom.errorMessage = 'Choose a valid date range.'
			return
		result = kanoaScripts.custom.ops.receiving.getScheduledReceivingOrders(self.view.custom.startDate, self.view.custom.endDate)
		self.view.custom.orders = result.get('data', {}).get('orders', [])
		self.view.custom.errorMessage = '' if result.get('status') == 'SUCCESS' else result.get('message', 'Could not load schedule.')

	except Exception as exc:
		kanoaScripts.custom.ops.receiving.getLogger().error('Receiving schedule refresh failed: %s' % str(exc))

	finally:

config.script:
selected = self.view.custom.selectedOrder
	if not selected:
		self.view.custom.errorMessage = 'Select an order from the schedule first.'
		return
	result = kanoaScripts.custom.ops.receiving.getReceivingOrder(selected.get('workOrderId'))
	if result.get('status') != 'SUCCESS':
		self.view.custom.errorMessage = result.get('message', 'The order could not be confirmed.')
		return
	order = result.get('data', {}).get('order', {})
	system.perspective.navigate(view='training/receiveMaterial', params={'value': {
		'workOrderId': order.get('workOrderId'),
		'scheduleBlockId': selected.get('scheduleBlockId'),
		'order': order
	}})

startDate = self.view.custom.startDate
	endDate = self.view.custom.endDate
	if startDate is None:
		startDate = system.date.addDays(system.date.midnight(system.date.now()), -7)
	if endDate is None:
		endDate = system.date.addDays(system.date.midnight(system.date.now()), 14)
	self.view.custom.startDate = startDate
	self.view.custom.endDate = endDate
	self.view.custom.loading = True
	try:
		result = kanoaScripts.custom.ops.receiving.getScheduledReceivingOrders(startDate, endDate)
		self.view.custom.orders = result.get('data', {}).get('orders', [])
		self.view.custom.errorMessage = '' if result.get('status') == 'SUCCESS' else result.get('message', 'Could not load schedule.')
	except Exception as exc:
		kanoaScripts.custom.ops.receiving.getLogger().error('Receiving schedule startup failed: %s' % str(exc))
		self.view.custom.errorMessage = 'Could not load the receiving schedule. Refresh the screen or contact a supervisor.'
	finally:
		self.view.custom.loading = False
